item.title: Prayer Not Manifesting, Trusting God’s Sovereign Will
item.description: In this episode of New Age to Christ, Doreen Virtue explains why Christians must reject manifesting, vision boards, and spiritual shortcuts, and instead trust biblical prayer that submits to God’s sovereign will.

item.title: Recognizing the Marks of a False Teacher
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains the biblical marks of a false teacher and why discernment is essential for protecting the gospel and guarding the church.

item.title: Job 14: Life Is Brief, but Resurrection Hope Endures
item.description: In Job 14, Job reflects on the brevity of life, the certainty of death, and the resurrection hope fulfilled in Jesus Christ.

item.title: The New Apostolic Reformation and the Sufficiency of Scripture
item.description: Dave Jenkins examines the New Apostolic Reformation and explains why its teachings contradict the sufficiency and authority of Scripture.

item.title: Job 15: When Truth Lacks Compassion
item.description: In Job 15, Eliphaz speaks with certainty but without compassion. This episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave explains the danger of misapplied truth and points listeners to Christ, who perfectly unites justice and mercy.

item.title: Counterfeit Spirituality: When Experience Replaces God’s Word
item.description: In this Weekly Watch episode of Contending for the Word, Dave Jenkins explains counterfeit spirituality, why experience-driven faith is appealing, and how Christians must test the spirits biblically.
